Summerize results

Wei Sun

2025-10-31

R libraries.

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(truncnorm)
library(pheatmap)
library(patchwork)

library(tidyr)
theme_set(theme_classic())

Read in DE results

mat <- read.table("step6_summarize_results/JAX_DE_data.tsv", sep = "\t")
dim(mat)
## [1] 23284    57
mat[1:2, 1:5]
##      ISL1_day_6 EPAS1_hypoxia_day_6 EPAS1_day_6 FOSB_day_6 GCM1_day_6
## TNMD     0.0000              0.0000      0.0000     0.0000  0.0000000
## DPM1     0.1485              0.1495      0.0625    -0.0725 -0.2981947
info <- fread("step6_summarize_results/JAX_DE_summary.tsv", sep = "\t")
dim(info)
## [1] 80 15
info[1:2,1:5]
##                              release   gene condition    day nGenes
##                               <char> <char>    <char> <char>  <int>
## 1: 2023_12_JAX_RNAseq_ExtraEmbryonic   ISL1            day_6  23842
## 2: 2023_12_JAX_RNAseq_ExtraEmbryonic  EPAS1   hypoxia  day_6  23326

ExM + PrS

mat_em = mat[,names(mat) %in% info$key[info$model_system %in% c("ExM", "PrS")]]
dim(mat_em)
## [1] 23284    36
dim(mat_em)
## [1] 23284    36
mat_em[1:2,1:4]
##      ISL1_day_6 EPAS1_hypoxia_day_6 EPAS1_day_6 FOSB_day_6
## TNMD     0.0000              0.0000      0.0000     0.0000
## DPM1     0.1485              0.1495      0.0625    -0.0725
gene_means = rowMeans(mat_em, na.rm = TRUE)
gene_sds = apply(mat_em, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(gene_means)
##     Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
## -0.52882 -0.04741  0.00000 -0.00722  0.04206  0.57245
summary(gene_sds)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
##  0.0000  0.1693  0.2394  0.2760  0.3380  1.2037
table(gene_sds > 0.1)
## 
## FALSE  TRUE 
##  1534 21750
mat_em = mat_em[gene_sds > 0.1,]

ko_means = colMeans(mat_em, na.rm = TRUE)
ko_sds = apply(mat_em, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

summary(ko_means)
##       Min.    1st Qu.     Median       Mean    3rd Qu.       Max. 
## -8.561e-02 -1.446e-02  2.644e-05 -7.770e-03  9.839e-03  3.977e-02
summary(ko_sds)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
## 0.05642 0.17974 0.27537 0.29958 0.38985 0.68043
df_ko = data.frame(mean = ko_means, sd = ko_sds)
library(ggrepel)

ggplot(df_ko, aes(x = mean, y = sd, label = rownames(df_ko))) +
  geom_point(color = "tomato", size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean Expression",
    y = "Standard Deviation",
    title = "Mean vs. SD of Knockout Profiles"
  )

pca_res <- prcomp(t(mat_em), scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)
pve <- (pca_res$sdev^2) / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
round(pve[1:5],3)
## [1] 0.202 0.122 0.082 0.076 0.054
# Extract the first two PCs
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  key = colnames(mat_em)
)

df_info = merge(pca_df, info, all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE)
dim(df_info)
## [1] 36 17
df_info[1:2,]
##                   key       PC1       PC2                            release
## 1 ASCL2_hypoxia_day_6 24.536019 -3.506738               2025_06_JAX_RNAseq08
## 2       BHLHE40_day_6  5.506278 14.590238 2024_05_JAX_RNAseq2_ExtraEmbryonic
##      gene condition   day nGenes nDE_05 nDE_01 ko_strategy
## 1   ASCL2   hypoxia day_6  22499   4831   1825         PTC
## 2 BHLHE40           day_6  23756   1461    484         PTC
##     expression_alteration.label model_system
## 1   JAX_ASCL2_Termination_codon          PrS
## 2 JAX_BHLHE40_Termination_codon          PrS
##                                 model_organ
## 1 Extra-embryonic primitive syncytial cells
## 2 Extra-embryonic primitive syncytial cells
##                                                               label
## 1 PrS-MOK20098P-B06-hyp;PrS-MOK20098P-D02-hyp;PrS-MOK20098P-E05-hyp
## 2             PrS-MOK20045P-B12;PrS-MOK20045P-C11;PrS-MOK20045P-D09
##                                                                                                                                         description
## 1 KOLF2.2J derived knockout cell line, ASCL2 PTC, differentiated to the trophoblast lineage and favoring primitive syncytium formation in 3% oxygen
## 2                                             KOLF2.2 deleted BHLHE40 by insertion of premature termination codon (PTC) derived primitive syncytium
##   max_nDE_01
## 1       1825
## 2        484
# Scatter plot of PC1 vs PC2
ggplot(df_info, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = model_system, label = key)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 30, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Model System",
    title = "PCA: PC1 vs PC2"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90")
  )
## Warning: ggrepel: 12 unlabeled data points (too many overlaps). Consider
## increasing max.overlaps

ht <- pheatmap(
  mat_em,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  scale = "none",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  na_col = "grey90",
  fontsize_col = 8,
  main = "PrS + ExM"
)

CBO
